instruction: Extract admitted applicant's name and email, write a Graduate Program Admission Letter draft in admission.pdf with applicant name as Dear student, and send the content of the pdf to each applicant's email with subject admission, swapping the applicant's name into the letter

Congratulations! We are pleased to inform you that you have been admitted to the Graduate Program at the University of Illinois Chicago (UIC). We were impressed by your academic achievements and believe you will be a valuable addition to our community.

We look forward to welcoming you to campus. Please review the enclosed information regarding your admission and next steps.

Sincerely,
Graduate Admissions Office
University of Illinois at Chicago"}
